const locales = ["en-US"] as const;
const mutable: string[] = ["en-US"];
const frozen = Object.freeze(["en-US", "en-GB"]);
console.log((1234).toLocaleString(locales), new Number(5).toLocaleString(locales));
console.log((1234).toLocaleString(mutable, { useGrouping: false }), (1234).toLocaleString("en-US"));
console.log((1234).toLocaleString(frozen, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }));
console.log((5678n).toLocaleString(locales));
